rasterMosaic.title: Raster Quick View - Mosaic

rasterMosaic.workflowDescription: A Raster Mosaic task scans TIFF/GeoTIFF files under the source node, creates COG leaves, a global overview COG, and a mosaic manifest as needed. Results are not written to infra MinIO.
